children: Parekh Sonalee Elizabeth, an officer serving as Chief Financial Officer, executed a sell-to-cover transaction on October 6, 2026. The sale was for 51,703 shares of Class A Common Stock at $25.33 per share. The total sale amount reported was $1,309,636. Following the transaction, Parekh directly owned 890,914 shares of Class A Common Stock. The filing states the sale was an issuer-mandated sell-to-cover to satisfy tax withholding obligations and that certain shares remain subject to forfeiture if vesting conditions are not met.
